hard_days.claim_template: If blend_gain_pct.hard > blend_gain_pct.easy, the blend earns its keep precisely on the days that matter.

oracle.definition: oracle = best single model chosen in hindsight for each day; recovery = share of the oracle's MAE advantage over the best fixed single model that the blend achieves

ai_ablation.definition: physics_only = equal-weight GFS+IFS mean (pre-AI operational practice); ai_value_pct > 0 means the AI-including blend beats it

imd_classes.note: zone-mean daily rainfall; test split is the NE-monsoon/winter period (rain events are rarer there than in the full year)

trust_audit.interpretation: A negative rank correlation and monotone increasing mean error across tiers means the issued trust is informative: higher trust forecasts really do err less.

calibration_sanity.note: positive improvement_pct means the bias-correction step reduced test MAE for that variable
